The structure of K2CoO2 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms—K8Co4O8—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with four O neighbors at 1.895–1.986 Å, K centers with eight O neighbors at 2.652–2.947 Å, and O centers with three neighbors (one Co, two K). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between K 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner-sharing between K and O polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 20 sites.
